=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## story architecture
summary:      Define the interpreter architecture and module boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
context:      TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     interpreter architecture, executable boundary
consumes:
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Define the Python standard-library architecture for lexing, parsing, AST evaluation, builtins, paths, runtime errors, and the executable entry point.

## story delivery-assets
summary:      Stage and validate the supplied conformance assets.
type:         foundational
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Verification-Assets.md
covers:       DELIVERY-002
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md, sources/run_conformance.py, sources/full_test.sh, sources/exclusions.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/run_conformance.py: conformance harness
  sources/full_test.sh: conformance harness
  sources/exclusions.txt: conformance harness
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/parser.y: normative specification
  sources/lexer.l: normative specification
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     staged verification assets
consumes:     interpreter architecture
acceptance:   yes
depends:      architecture
instructions: |
  Preserve the supplied sources verbatim and document how the executable and conformance harness are used.

## story frontend-lexer
summary:      Tokenize jq source according to the supplied lexical rules.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Lexer.md
covers:       FRONTEND-001
context:      sources/lexer.l, sources/jq-manual.txt
context_roles: |
  sources/lexer.l: normative specification
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     jq lexer
consumes:     interpreter architecture
acceptance:   yes
depends:      architecture, delivery-assets
instructions: |
  Implement jq tokenization, comments, literals, identifiers, bindings, formats, strings, interpolation delimiters, escapes, and lexical errors.

## story frontend-parser
summary:      Parse jq programs into an executable AST.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Parser.md
covers:       FRONTEND-002
context:      sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l, sources/jq-manual.txt
context_roles: |
  sources/parser.y: normative specification
  sources/lexer.l: normative specification
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     jq parser and AST
consumes:     jq lexer, interpreter architecture
acceptance:   yes
depends:      frontend-lexer
instructions: |
  Implement precedence, associativity, expressions, definitions, patterns, modules, control syntax, and AST construction.

## story frontend-diagnostics
summary:      Reject invalid jq programs with compile status 3.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Compile-Diagnostics.md
covers:       FRONTEND-003
context:      sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt
context_roles: |
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/parser.y: normative specification
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     compile-time diagnostics, exit status 3
consumes:     jq parser and AST
acceptance:   yes
depends:      frontend-parser
instructions: |
  Distinguish syntax and static failures from runtime failures and reject all applicable corpus failure cases with exit code 3.

## story core-streams
summary:      Evaluate jq filters as ordered value streams.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Stream-Evaluation.md
covers:       CORE-001
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     generator evaluation, identity, empty, literals, stream ordering
consumes:     jq parser and AST
acceptance:   yes
depends:      frontend-diagnostics
instructions: |
  Build the generator evaluation model with zero, one, and many outputs, preserving ordering, multiplicity, and partial output.

## story core-composition
summary:      Implement jq composition, operators, and cartesian evaluation.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Composition.md
covers:       CORE-002
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     pipes, commas, indexing, iteration, arithmetic, comparison, function argument evaluation
consumes:     generator evaluation
acceptance:   yes
depends:      core-streams
instructions: |
  Implement pipes, comma streams, field and array access, iteration, operators, and cartesian products over generator arguments.

## story core-construction
summary:      Implement array and object construction filters.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Construction.md
covers:       CORE-003
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/parser.y: normative specification
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     array construction, object construction, interpolation
consumes:     generator evaluation, jq parser and AST
acceptance:   yes
depends:      core-composition
instructions: |
  Collect generator outputs into arrays and construct objects with literal, shorthand, computed, and interpolated keys.

## story paths-navigation
summary:      Implement jq paths and mutation primitives.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-Paths.md
covers:       PATHS-001
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     path, getpath, setpath, delpaths, indexing, slicing, deletion
consumes:     array and object construction, generator evaluation
acceptance:   yes
depends:      core-construction
instructions: |
  Implement path discovery, path reads and writes, deletion, indexing, slicing, invalid-path behavior, and boundary handling.

## story paths-assignment
summary:      Implement jq assignment operators over paths.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-Assignments.md
covers:       PATHS-002
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     plain assignment, update assignment, arithmetic assignment, defined-or assignment
consumes:     path navigation and mutation primitives
acceptance:   yes
depends:      paths-navigation
instructions: |
  Implement immutable path-based assignment with generator-aware RHS behavior and deletion when updates produce empty.

## story control-conditionals
summary:      Implement jq conditionals and boolean/default operators.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Conditionals.md
covers:       CONTROL-001
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     if, elif, else, and, or, not, defined-or
consumes:     generator evaluation, path assignments
acceptance:   yes
depends:      paths-assignment
instructions: |
  Implement jq truthiness, branching over generator results, boolean operators, not, and fallback semantics.

## story control-errors
summary:      Implement runtime errors, catches, halting, and optional filters.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Errors.md
covers:       CONTROL-002
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     error, try, catch, halt, halt_error, optional filters, exit status 5
consumes:     generator evaluation, conditionals
acceptance:   yes
depends:      control-conditionals
instructions: |
  Implement runtime error propagation and catching, optional expressions, halting, diagnostics, and exit status 5 while preserving prior output.

## story control-reductions
summary:      Implement reductions and generator iteration controls.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Reductions.md
covers:       CONTROL-003
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     reduce, foreach, range, limit, skip, first, last, nth, while, until, repeat
consumes:     generator evaluation, runtime errors
acceptance:   yes
depends:      control-errors
instructions: |
  Implement reductions, iteration controls, stream truncation, and recursive generator helpers with correct backtracking.

## story control-recursion
summary:      Implement labels, breaks, recursion, and recursive descent.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Recursion.md
covers:       CONTROL-004
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     label, break, recurse, recursive user filters, recursive descent
consumes:     reductions, runtime errors
acceptance:   yes
depends:      control-reductions
instructions: |
  Implement lexical labels and breaks, recurse forms, recursive descent, and recursive user-filter execution.

## story functions-bindings
summary:      Implement lexical bindings and destructuring patterns.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Bindings.md
covers:       FUNCTIONS-001
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/parser.y: normative specification
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     as bindings, lexical scopes, closures, destructuring patterns
consumes:     parser and AST, generator evaluation, recursion
acceptance:   yes
depends:      control-recursion
instructions: |
  Implement lexical variable environments, array/object patterns, null bindings, closures, and binding scope.

## story functions-user
summary:      Implement user-defined jq functions.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-User-Functions.md
covers:       FUNCTIONS-002
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/parser.y: normative specification
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     def functions, recursive definitions, filter arguments, value arguments, arity and redefinition
consumes:     lexical bindings, generator evaluation
acceptance:   yes
depends:      functions-bindings
instructions: |
  Implement function definitions, lexical function scope, filter and value parameters, recursion, closures, arity, and redefinition.

## story functions-alternatives
summary:      Implement destructuring alternatives.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Destructuring-Alternatives.md
covers:       FUNCTIONS-003
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/parser.y: normative specification
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     ?// destructuring alternatives
consumes:     lexical bindings, user-defined functions, runtime errors
acceptance:   yes
depends:      functions-user
instructions: |
  Implement alternative pattern matching, fallback bindings, null exposure for unmatched names, and error-triggered alternatives.

## story builtins-types
summary:      Implement type, conversion, predicate, containment, and environment builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        7
implements:   FEATURE-Builtins-Types.md
covers:       BUILTINS-001
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     type and conversion builtins, predicates, containment, keys, environment
consumes:     user-defined functions, runtime errors
acceptance:   yes
depends:      functions-alternatives
instructions: |
  Implement core value inspection, conversions, predicates, containment, key inspection, and environment primitives.

## story builtins-collections
summary:      Implement collection and object builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        7
implements:   FEATURE-Builtins-Collections.md
covers:       BUILTINS-002
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     sorting, grouping, uniqueness, mapping, entries, joins, flattening, combinations, transpose, collection paths
consumes:     type and conversion builtins, path navigation, user-defined functions
acceptance:   yes
depends:      builtins-types
instructions: |
  Implement collection transformations, ordering, grouping, uniqueness, mapping, object-entry conversion, flattening, combinations, transpose, and related builtins.

## story builtins-strings
summary:      Implement string, format, and regular-expression builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        7
implements:   FEATURE-Builtins-Strings.md
covers:       BUILTINS-003
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     string operations, interpolation, formats, regex matching, substitution, splitting
consumes:     type and conversion builtins, user-defined functions
acceptance:   yes
depends:      builtins-collections
instructions: |
  Implement string trimming and case operations, JSON and shell formats, URI and encoding formats, regex matching, captures, scanning, splitting, substitution, and interpolation.

## story builtins-datetime
summary:      Implement date and time builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        7
implements:   FEATURE-Builtins-DateTime.md
covers:       BUILTINS-004
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     date parsing, formatting, epoch conversion, gmtime, localtime, mktime
consumes:     string builtins, runtime errors
acceptance:   yes
depends:      builtins-strings
instructions: |
  Implement UTC date parsing and formatting, epoch conversion, broken-down time operations, and declared invalid-input behavior.

## story builtins-io
summary:      Implement streaming, I/O, debugging, and SQL-style builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        7
implements:   FEATURE-Builtins-IO.md
covers:       BUILTINS-005
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/builtin.jq: reference implementation
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     input, inputs, debug, stderr, tostream, fromstream, walk, INDEX, JOIN, IN
consumes:     collection builtins, string builtins, runtime input stream
acceptance:   yes
depends:      builtins-datetime
instructions: |
  Implement additional input consumption, debug and stderr behavior, stream conversion, recursive walk, and SQL-style operators.

## story numbers-arithmetic
summary:      Implement jq numeric arithmetic, ordering, and math.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        8
implements:   FEATURE-Numbers.md
covers:       NUMBERS-001
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     numeric arithmetic, ordering, IEEE special values, mathematical functions
consumes:     type and conversion builtins, runtime errors
acceptance:   yes
depends:      builtins-io
instructions: |
  Implement numeric arithmetic, modulo, comparisons, IEEE special values, numeric ordering, math functions, and formatting semantics.

## story numbers-boundaries
summary:      Handle numeric, Unicode, depth, and boundary cases.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        8
implements:   FEATURE-Numeric-Boundaries.md
covers:       NUMBERS-002
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
context_roles: |
  sources/jq-manual.txt: normative specification
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     large literals, Unicode codepoints, depth limits, invalid indices, boundary errors
consumes:     numeric arithmetic and ordering, paths, serialization
acceptance:   yes
depends:      numbers-arithmetic
instructions: |
  Implement large-number literal handling, Unicode boundary behavior, depth protections, invalid indices, and documented edge cases.

## story delivery-interface
summary:      Deliver the executable jq command-line interface.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        9
implements:   FEATURE-Executable-Interface.md
covers:       DELIVERY-001
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
context_roles: |
  sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md: author intent
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     executable ./jq, -c interface, JSON stdin/stdout protocol
consumes:     parser, evaluator, builtins, numeric boundaries
acceptance:   yes
depends:      numbers-boundaries
instructions: |
  Deliver an executable root-level jq that accepts -c and a filter, reads JSON values from stdin, emits compact JSON values per line, and returns the documented statuses.

## story delivery-conformance
summary:      Prove the completed interpreter against the full conformance corpus.
type:         feature
kind:         test harness
phase:        10
implements:   FEATURE-Complete-Conformance.md
accepts:       st-001
context:      sources/run_conformance.py, sources/full_test.sh, sources/jq.test, sources/exclusions.txt
context_roles: |
  sources/run_conformance.py: conformance harness
  sources/full_test.sh: conformance harness
  sources/jq.test: normative specification and conformance test suite
  sources/exclusions.txt: conformance harness
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     complete jq conformance verdict
consumes:     executable ./jq, staged verification assets
acceptance:   yes
depends:      delivery-interface
instructions: |
  Run the supplied full conformance command as the terminal verification step and require the complete non-excluded corpus to pass.
